selectors.ram: F750 bits 0-4: FD2C.8 start, FD2C.9 idle | FD42.13, FD2C.10 part load | FD42.13, FD2C.11 overrun, FD2C.12 overrun cut
selectors.evidence: 0C:467E builds F750 from FD2D with FD42.13 ORed into bits 1 and 2 (0x44692/0x44696 BOR R6.1/R6.2, FD42.13); FD2C.7-.12 are one-hot, each BSET paired with BFLDL FD9A,#7 (0x29B6C-0x2AE10); FD42.13 (full-load enrichment) is written only at 0x3D472/0x3D476/0x3D4C8

selectors.ram: F751: bit 1 FD9C.8 (AT in gear), bit 3 FD9A.5 | FD9E.3 | FD9E.4 (cat-heating phases 1-3)
selectors.evidence: 0x446B2-0x446BA BMOV R6.11,FD9A.5; BOR R6.11,FD9E.3; BOR R6.11,FD9E.4; F750 bit 9 = FD9C.8 (0C:467E)
0C:467E: F752 = 820D & 0xFF03 | ...; the cam setpoint selector runs only in mode 2 (0B:2EEE)
0x4476A MOV R8,E31Ch; MOV F760h,R8. E31C has one writer, 0x34938 (curve 0x7B690 on valve overlap 8C08); E31D is its high byte
0x4488A MOVB RL7,E305h into frame 0x40; the ignition code reads the byte E305 only (0x2C66A)
frame 0x12 = E33A (0C:467E); E33B is its high byte, with no byte writes to E33B in the code; 0B:D3BA compares the byte E33B

curves.name: id_maf_fl_ivvt__n
curves.evidence: 0B:D3BA-D3E0: FD38.14 := E33B > id_maf_fl_ivvt__n(E0E4); 16 bytes on the rpm axis 0x74B6C, not interpolated (code catalogue, ms43x001_live_inputs.json); 30 at every rpm on the car bin, read from the open bin because it can be edited

factors.evidence: 0x2C648-0x2C678: 81C8 = ron98 + round((ron91 - ron98) * E305 / 255); E305 = 0 is all RON98, 255 all RON91
flex fuel off (cal 0x70DF8 = 0): 8483 = cal 0x70A10 - 0x80; blend 0D:1850 = b + trunc((a - b) * f / 32), f signed. With flex fuel on, 8483 = curve 0x7D654(8487) - 0x80, not modelled
flex fuel off: 8484 = cal 0x70A11 - 0x80 (read MOVBS 8484h at 0x2C68E); with flex fuel on, curve 0x7D664(8487) - 0x80, not modelled
flex fuel off: 8486 = cal 0x70A13 - 0x80; with flex fuel on, curve 0x7D684(8487) - 0x80, not modelled

rules.title: VE maps
rules.inferred: That with the MAF load source the VE maps steer the modelled manifold pressure and the transients, not steady fuelling (from the observed formulas, not a run).
rules.evidence: 0x3B9DA-0x3BA48: i = E31D - 1, unsigned clamp to 7; i < 7 reads ve[i] x (255 - E31C&0xFF)*128 and ve[i+1] x (E31C&0xFF)*128 (0D:1900 scales by /32768), added saturating (0D:1184); i = 7 reads ve[7] alone. Called on all three load-source paths (0x3B550, 0x3B632, 0x3B70E); the only writer of load E33A
rules.caveat: With the MAF load source (cal 0x70DF3 = 1 on the car) the VE result sets the modelled manifold pressure and the transients, not steady fuelling. The weights add up to 255/256 in the firmware.

rules.title: Ignition, part load
rules.inferred: That part load always reads these maps: the guard also skips them while FD2C.4 is set, every traced path into part load clears FD2C.4, but not every path was traced.
rules.evidence: 0x2C2EC branches on FD9A & 7 (1 start, 2 idle, else 0x2C608); guard 0x2C608-0x2C624 reads these maps when FD2C.10 (part load); 0x2C648-0x2C678: 81C8 = ron98 + round((ron91 - ron98) * E305 / 255) (0D:1516); 0x2C67C-0x2C696: 81D3 = blend(e85, 81C8, 8484) (0D:1850)
rules.caveat: In overrun the maps are read or not depending on FD2C.2/.4 and FD30.3, which are not logged. While full-load enrichment runs the frame cannot tell idle from part load.

cases.why: Overrun: the choice depends on bits the logger does not carry.
Full-load enrichment hides idle and part load in the logged state.

rules.title: Ignition, idle
rules.evidence: 0x2C2EC: FD9A & 7 = 2 (written with FD2C.9) jumps to 0x2C37C, which reads ron98_is and e85_is blended by 8484 (0D:1850); no RON91 map and no octane term
rules.caveat: While full-load enrichment runs the frame cannot tell idle from part load.

cases.why: Full-load enrichment hides idle and part load in the logged state.

rules.title: Ignition, optimum (torque model)
rules.inferred: That 8025 is the torque model's optimum angle rather than the fired spark (from how it is used with 81C1).
rules.evidence: 0x10258-0x102A2: 8022 = optm_ron98; 8025 = blend(optm_e85, 8022, 8484), on every run of the routine at 09:0000
rules.caveat: A torque-model reference that limits torque interventions, not the fired spark.

rules.title: Full-load AFR target
rules.evidence: 0B:D3AA-D42A reads both maps (0x3D40A, 0x3D41A) blended by 8483; the result reaches fuelling (91A0, 0C:AFA2) only while FD42.13 is set, else 91A0 = 0; frame state bits 1-2 = 11 exactly when FD42.13 is set
rules.caveat: Launch control is enabled on the car (cal 0x7132C = 1): at standstill with the pedal at or above cal 0x7132E the target is at least 130 (FDF8.0, not logged). The applied target is logged as AFTARGET (frame 0x42).

rules.title: VANOS intake, idle
rules.evidence: 0B:39A4 JB FD2C.9 selects the idle maps; intake = blend(0x7636C, 0x76184, 8486), reads at 0B:39D4/39E4; the selector runs only in VANOS mode 2 (0B:2EEE)
rules.caveat: Adders for idle and the cat-heating hold follow the map (0B:3A24, 0B:3C2A).

cases.why: Full-load enrichment hides idle and part load in the logged state.

rules.title: VANOS exhaust, idle
rules.evidence: 0B:39A4 JB FD2C.9 selects the idle maps; exhaust = blend(0x76278, 0x76090, 8486), reads at 0B:3A00/3A10; the selector runs only in VANOS mode 2 (0B:2EEE)
rules.caveat: Adders for idle and the cat-heating hold follow the map (0B:3A24, 0B:3C2A).

rules.title: VANOS intake, part load
rules.inferred: That FD38.14 is fresh whenever the frame shows part load or full-load enrichment: it is recomputed only with the pedal off idle (FD44.3, not logged), and part load with the pedal released lasts only until the state machine moves to idle or overrun (transitions traced, the timing not measured).
rules.evidence: 0B:39A4: not idle -> JNB FD38.14 picks the part-load maps (0B:3ACC-0B:3C26), else the full-load curves (0B:3AD8-3B20), each blended with its E85 twin by 8486; only in VANOS mode 2 (0B:2EEE). FD38.14 := E33B > curve 0x75D7F(E0E4), recomputed only while FD44.3 (pedal at idle) is clear (0B:D3B2-D3E0)
rules.caveat: With FD9C.3 clear (not logged) the result is pulled toward 160/120, about 85 % of the map's deviation still applies.

cases.why: Overrun: the pedal is released, so FD38.14 (part or full load) keeps the value it had before, which the logger does not carry.
Start or stopped: FD38.14 (part or full load) is recomputed only with the pedal pressed, which the frame shows only in part load and full-load enrichment.

rules.title: Catalyst heating ignition, phase 1
rules.inferred: What each cat-heating bit means (phase 1 hold and fade, phase 2 standstill, phase 3 idle); the not-in-use cases are read in the code.
rules.evidence: read only while FD9A.5 is set and the engine is not idling (FD9C.3 picks which of the two); not applied in full load; with FD9A.5, FD9E.3 and FD9E.4 clear every clear path has reset 849C/849D/E382 to neutral
rules.caveat: With the cat-heating bit set the frame cannot tell the three phases apart, and the fade factors (km counter, coolant, time after start) are not logged.

rules.title: Catalyst heating ignition, idle
rules.inferred: What each cat-heating bit means (phase 1 hold and fade, phase 2 standstill, phase 3 idle); the not-in-use cases are read in the code.
rules.evidence: read while FD9A.5 is set at idle, or while FD9E.4 (phase 3: idle, or part load at zero speed) is set
rules.caveat: With the cat-heating bit set the frame cannot tell the three phases apart, and the fade factors are not logged.

rules.title: Catalyst heating, phase 2 and fuel
rules.inferred: What each cat-heating bit means (phase 1 hold and fade, phase 2 standstill, phase 3 idle); the not-in-use cases are read in the code.
rules.evidence: ip_iga_ch_2 is read only while FD9E.3 is set (0D:D8D4); ip_ti_ch only while FD52.14 is set, which implies FD9A.5
rules.caveat: With the cat-heating bit set the frame cannot tell the three phases apart, and the fade factors are not logged.

rules.title: Catalyst heating VANOS factor
rules.inferred: What each cat-heating bit means (phase 1 hold and fade, phase 2 standstill, phase 3 idle); the not-in-use cases are read in the code.
rules.evidence: read at 0x33C3E only while FD52.13 (implies FD9A.5) and FD9C.8 (AT in gear) are set; with FD9C.8 clear nothing is added
rules.caveat: With both bits set the frame cannot tell the hold from the fade or from phases 2 and 3.

leftOut.why: Read only while FD18.15 is set, which the logger does not carry (knock adaptation).
Blended by coolant at start (8450), which the logger does not carry.
